display_name: Test: Access model work and USB policy
description: Test of access model slice 9.2: the USB policy (a PC refuses a storage stick and its owner takes it to a kiosk; a keyboard-type device gets through; a dock refuses the player's own plant; a tray under a blocking default accepts). Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove usbClass and the usb policy field: npc_use_refused, the usb_refused mutter, delivery to a permitted object, the put-down with nowhere else, the player's refused plant, and that only workstations and objects naming a policy are governed
